learnings: Models must distinguish between packaging hygiene concerns (unconventional mirrors, proxies) and actual injection risks—checksum-pinned sources are safe regardless of how unconventional the URLs appear
API errors during file review should trigger retries or fallback models rather than producing inconclusive security verdicts that block package approval
The self-correction mechanism (second look) effectively caught and resolved the false positive from openrouter/free, demonstrating the value of multi-pass review for borderline cases
